conventions: bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps) of the recorded file resolution; fixed = codecs whose bitrate does not scale with resolution/fps choice
convention_red: REDCODE: bpp = factor/ratio with factor = bits/photosite used by RED's Recording Time tool (14 for DRAGON-X, 12 for MYSTERIUM-X), same method as red.json.

cameras.name: RED DSMC2 Dragon-X 6K S35
cameras.notes: DSMC2 brain with DRAGON-X 6K S35 sensor (19.4 MP, 30.7x15.8 mm, 6144x3160); 6K capture requires firmware 7.3+ (earlier units sold as Dragon-X 5K). REDCODE is a user-selected ratio (2:1-22:1); bpp per ratio = 14/ratio per RED's own Recording Time tool model (14 bits/photosite for DRAGON-class sensors), same method as red.json. Max media throughput 300 MB/s (RED MINI-MAG 480GB+), 225 MB/s on 120/240GB MINI-MAGs - lowest ratio usable depends on resolution x fps. Resolutions: RED spec max fps for FF/2.4:1 at 6K-2K; other aspect formats (2:1, 16:9, 6:5, 5.5K, 4.5K) from RED Recording Time tool list (also has 3.5K/2.5K, 3:2, 4:3, 5:4, 4:1, 8:1 variants not included). HDRx doubles the R3D data rate. ProRes rates are Apple white-paper targets (estimated); DNxHR/DNxHD rates not found from Avid/RED (null). Real R3D files are VBR and average near or slightly below nominal.

resolutions.name: 6K Full Format
resolutions.note: RED spec 6144x3160; RED Recording Time tool lists 6144x3240

codecs.name: REDCODE 2:1
codecs.ref: bpp = 14/2 (RED Recording Time tool: MB/s = W*H*14/8*fps/ratio/1e6; camera 'DSMC2 DRAGON-X' factor 14, REDCODE 2:1-22:1, max media output 300 MB/s). Check vs RED spec 'Best available REDCODE' at 300 MB/s: 6K FF 24fps 3:1 (model 2.59->3), 60fps 7:1 (6.48->7), 4K FF 24fps 2:1 (1.18->2), 120fps 6:1 (5.9->6) - all match.

codecs.name: ProRes 4444 XQ
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE: RED does not publish ProRes data rates; Apple ProRes White Paper (April 2022) appendix target rates at 24p: 2k-ff 453 Mb/s (bpp 8.5336). ProRes is VBR (max ~10% above target). RED spec: ProRes 422 HQ/422/LT at 4K (4096x2160) up to 30 fps; ProRes 4444 XQ/4444/422 HQ/422/LT at 2K (2048x1080) up to 120 fps. ProRes/DNx can be recorded instead of R3D or alongside it as a proxy.

cameras.name: RED EPIC Mysterium-X (EPIC-M / EPIC-X 5K)
cameras.notes: DSMC1 EPIC with MYSTERIUM-X 5K S35 sensor (5120x2700, 27.7x14.6 mm). R3D only - no in-camera ProRes/DNx (REDCINE-X/RED ROCKET transcode). Formats and pixel dimensions from RED EPIC/SCARLET Operation Guide 955-0156 (EPIC MYSTERIUM-X and SCARLET MYSTERIUM-X Formats); anamorphic formats share the same pixel dimensions. Max fps from RED DSMC Operation Guide (mirror of RED doc 955-0020) table: 23.98 time base, 8:1 compression, Lookaround disabled. Project time bases 23.98/24/25/29.97/47.95/48/50/59.94. REDCODE bpp = 12/ratio (estimated: EPIC MX is not in RED's tool; Scarlet MX entry gives factor 12). Max sustained data rate for REDMAG SSDs not found in a RED document for EPIC MX - not modelled. HDRx doubles data rate.

codecs.name: REDCODE 3:1
codecs.ref: bpp = 12/3 (RED Recording Time tool model MB/s = W*H*factor/8*fps/ratio/1e6 with factor 12 bits/photosite for MYSTERIUM-X - the tool lists SCARLET MYSTERIUM-X with factor 12; EPIC MX is not in the tool, so the same sensor factor is applied). Ratio range 3:1-18:1 per RED's original EPIC-X spec (third-party reproductions); not re-verified in a current RED document.
